name: Emeishan

queries.query: Emeishan Sichuan cadastral parcel map official GIS service
queries.result: First-party results identified the official Emeishan government site, an official notice describing the city electronic government map, and Sichuan natural-resources/Tianditu material. No anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint was exposed in indexed results.

queries.query: 峨眉山市 不动产 登记 地图 地籍 官方
queries.result: Official Chinese-language results identified the Emeishan Natural Resources Bureau real-estate registration center, its registration/cadastral survey and information-query duties, the city electronic government map notice, and the official Sichuan Tianditu platform. No open parcel feature response was found.

freshResearch.method: Web discovery followed by TLS-verified bounded GETs and inspection of the official viewer HTML/JavaScript/configuration; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement.

portalsFound.observation: Official Emeishan Natural Resources Bureau budget page states that the local real-estate registration center handles citywide real-estate registration, cadastral-survey result review, registration archives, and registration-information queries. This establishes local custodial responsibility, not an open parcel API.
Official city notice describes an electronic government map covering Emeishan government/service points and administrative communities; it is a public-service locator, not a cadastral parcel viewer.

Official Sichuan Tianditu viewer loaded anonymously. Current HTML and JavaScript/configuration exposed vector, imagery and terrain basemap WMTS routes at t4.tianditu.gov.cn, but no parcel/cadastral layer, feature schema, CRS metadata for parcels, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry route.
Official Sichuan map-open-platform host was attempted but timed out within the bounded request; no inference about cadastral absence was made.

requests.assessment: Viewer HTML loaded; configuration and current JavaScript inspected. Only public basemap WMTS routes were found.
Current configuration defines only map/imagery/terrain layer items; no parcel feature service or parcel schema was exposed.
Current viewer constants inspected for service routes; no cadastral endpoint identified.
Connection timed out after 20 seconds; access failure only, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Emeishan City local natural-resources and real-estate-registration administration, plus Sichuan public geospatial basemap services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local custodial/procedure evidence and public basemap viewer only; anonymous parcel geometry and citywide open coverage were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current local cadastral viewer/API route, access controls, parcel schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, update currency, legal access conditions and citywide coverage remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted; no exact-point hit or miss was inferred. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect an officially exposed Emeishan/Sichuan natural-resources viewer or approved public API route and issue only a bounded anonymous safe-ID-plus-geometry request if one is revealed.
